title: AI教母李飞飞新创业：世界模型能否超越ChatGPT？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I hear you love walking talks. Yes.
segments.zh: 听说你喜欢边走边聊。是的。

segments.en: Because we sit too much. Yeah, and also our company is next to the park.
segments.zh: 因为我们坐得太久了。而且我们公司就在公园旁边。

segments.en: So it's great. Is it all AI talk all the time here?
segments.zh: 所以很棒。这里是不是整天都在聊AI？

segments.en: I don't know. Other people's talk. But I talk AI all the time.
segments.zh: 不知道，别人聊什么。但我一直聊AI。

segments.en: But that's the only thing I know. Feifei Lee is a giant in the field of computer vision.
segments.zh: 但这是我唯一懂的。李飞飞是计算机视觉领域的巨擘。

segments.en: A branch of AI dedicated to teaching machines to see.
segments.zh: 这是AI的一个分支，专门教机器看懂图像。

segments.en: She made a breakthrough with ImageNet, a visual library that sparked the modern AI revolution, earning her the title, Godmother of AI.
segments.zh: 她通过ImageNet取得突破，这个视觉库点燃了现代AI革命，为她赢得了“AI教母”的称号。

segments.en: And she's been a pioneer at AI Center ever since, as a Stanford professor, a Google executive, an advisor to US presidents, and a relentless advocate for AI that serves people.
segments.zh: 此后她一直是AI领域的先驱，担任斯坦福教授、谷歌高管、美国总统顾问，并坚定倡导AI服务人类。

segments.en: I feel the leaders of AI are not talking enough about empowering humanity.
segments.zh: 我觉得AI领袖们对赋能人类谈得不够多。

segments.en: They're talking too much about replacing humanity, replacing jobs.
segments.zh: 他们谈得太多的是取代人类、取代工作。

segments.en: Now, she's adding startup co-founder to her star resume.
segments.zh: 如今，她又将初创公司联合创始人的头衔加进了自己耀眼的履历。

segments.en: What's it like running your own shop? I feel like a tiger wall.
segments.zh: 经营自己的公司是什么感觉？我感觉自己像一只猛虎。

segments.en: While the rest of the AI world doubles down on large language models like ChatGPT and Claude, Lee is betting on a new frontier, world models.
segments.zh: 当AI界其他人都专注于像ChatGPT和Claude这样的大型语言模型时，李飞飞押注的是一个新领域——世界模型。

segments.en: She's building AI that aims to predict what happens next in the real world, not just the next word in a sentence.
segments.zh: 她正在构建的AI旨在预测现实世界中接下来会发生什么，而不仅仅是句子中的下一个词。

segments.en: So what can world models do ultimately that LLMs will never be able to?
segments.zh: 那么，世界模型最终能做什么是LLM永远做不到的？

segments.en: Can words put down fires? Can words cook an omelette?
segments.zh: 文字能灭火吗？文字能煎蛋卷吗？
